visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of a cream-colored stand mixer kneading a dark chocolate-colored dough in a stainless steel bowl. The environment is a clean, bright indoor kitchen. (2) Hands use a white plastic scraper to cut a large piece of dark brown dough on a white marble surface. Lighting is bright and even. (3) The dough is divided into small, roughly shaped balls. Hands press and roll the dough pieces. (4) A pair of hands holds two Meiji chocolate bars—one in a brown wrapper and one in a black wrapper—against the backdrop of the dough balls. (5) A long strip of dough is flattened with a white textured rolling pin. A small rectangular piece of chocolate is placed at one end of the strip. (6) A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a navy blue long-sleeved shirt, is seen in a medium shot. She is carefully rolling the dough strips into crescent-shaped buns on a white marble counter. The kitchen background is modern with a window. (7) The woman places a tray of shaped buns into a black and white Healsio steam oven. She turns the dial on the oven interface. (8) Close-up of the oven display showing '40°C' and a countdown timer. Then the woman takes the tray out and adds coarse salt flakes on top of the buns. (9) The buns are placed back into the oven. The display shows '240°C'. (10) The finished dark brown buns are placed on a cooling rack. The woman, wearing a grey oven mitt, holds the tray. (11) An extreme close-up of the finished salt buns. Fingers press and tear one bun open, revealing a soft, porous interior and melted chocolate pieces. Yellow variety-show text appears as an overlay.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 開學第9週. (2) [Subtitle]: 我做了 脆皮巧克力鹽可頌. (3) [Subtitle]: 麵團是 低糖低油的版本. [Subtitle]: 一樣加了液種. (4) [Logo]: meiji. [Subtitle]: 這次的內餡很有趣. [Subtitle]: 我直接去便利商店買了 巧克力. (5) [Subtitle]: 一片片拆下來捲到 麵包裡面. (6) [Subtitle]: 方便買 孩子也很喜歡. (7) [Subtitle]: 鹽可頌整形稍微有 難一點. (8) [Subtitle]: 但烤出來層次分明 外酥內軟. (9) [Subtitle]: 只是開學一陣子了 女兒快要段考了. (10) [Subtitle]: 感覺她有點緊張 好像怕跟不上大家. (11) [Subtitle]: 但我想 她已經長大了 會自己找到辦法的. (12) [Subtitle]: 我能做的就是幫她 準備麵包. (13) [Subtitle]: 讓香氣 陪她度過考試囉. (14) [Subtitle]: 我跟自己說 媽媽我 已經做得很好好了. (15) [Subtitle]: 來看看這香噴噴的 鹽可頌吧. (16) [Subtitle]: 脆皮 微鹹. [Subtitle]: 裡面還有 半融化的巧克力. (17) [Variety]: 超好吃. (18) [Subtitle]: 不甜不膩 剛剛好.
